title: Colony and Protocol
author: O. M. Halloran
blurb: Juniper Amberdale, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
